strategy: 面积、周长与局部边界诱导

questions.question: Consider the perimeter and area of the region formed by the grey squares. How many more squares can be coloured grey so that the grey area increases without increasing its perimeter?

In which of the five pictures is the white area bigger than the grey area?
Choices:
A:A
B:B
C:C
D:D
E:E

Which square should replace the question mark so that the white and black areas are equal?
Choices:
A:A
B:B
C:C
D:D
E:E

How many of the following black-and-white flags have exactly three fifths of their area coloured black?
Choices:
A:None
B:One
C:Two
D:Three
E:Four
The rectangle shown on the right is divided into 7 squares. Each grey square has side length 8. What is the side length of the large white square?
Triangle $A B C$ is equilateral and has area 9. The dividing lines are parallel to the sides, and divide the sides into three equal lengths. What is the area of the grey shaded part of the triangle?

The big rectangle shown is divided into 30 equally big squares. The perimeter of the area shaded in grey is $240 \mathrm{~cm}$. How big is the area of the big rectangle?
Choices:
A:$480 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
B:$750 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
C:$1080 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
D:$1920 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
E:$2430 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$

A $3 \mathrm{~cm}$ wide strip is grey on one side and white on the other. The strip is folded so that it fits inside a rectangle of length $27 \mathrm{~cm}$, as shown. The grey trapeziums are identical. What is the length of the original strip?
Choices:
A:$36 \mathrm{~cm}$
B:$48 \mathrm{~cm}$
C:$54 \mathrm{~cm}$
D:$57 \mathrm{~cm}$
E:$81 \mathrm{~cm}$

In the figure, what is the ratio of the area of the gray squares to the area of the white squares?
Choices:
A:3:10
B:3:8
C:3:7
D:3:5
E:1:1
If the length of the side of a little square is 1, what is the area of the letter N?

A parallelogram is divided in two parts $P_{1}$ and $P_{2}$, as shown in the picture. Which sentence is always true?
Choices:
A:$P_{2}$ has a longer perimeter than $P_{1}$
B:$P_{2}$ has a smaller perimeter than $P_{1}$
C:$P_{2}$ has a smaller area than $P_{1}$
D:$P_{1}$ and $P_{2}$ have the same perimeter
E:$P_{1}$ and $P_{2}$ have the same area

The figure on the right has a perimeter of $42 \mathrm{~cm}$. The figure was made from eight equally sized squares. What is the area of the figure?
Choices:
A:$8 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
B:$9 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
C:$24 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
D:$72 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
E:$128 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
The shape shown consists of 6 squares of side length 1. What is its perimeter?

Four equally big squares are partially coloured in black. In which of the four squares is the total area of the black parts biggest?
Choices:
A:A
B:B
C:C
D:D
E:The total area of the black parts is always equally big.

Which of the five squares has the biggest proportion of black area?
Choices:
A:A
B:B
C:C
D:D
E:E

A panel consists of 4 circles. Touching a circle changes its color and the color of every circle touching it, from white to black or from black to white, as shown. Starting with all circles white, what is the minimum number of successive touches needed to turn all circles black?

The star shown in the picture is made by fitting together 12 congruent equilateral triangles. The perimeter of the star is $36 \mathrm{~cm}$. What is the perimeter of the grey hexagon?
Choices:
A:$6 \mathrm{~cm}$
B:$12 \mathrm{~cm}$
C:$18 \mathrm{~cm}$
D:$24 \mathrm{~cm}$
E:$30 \mathrm{~cm}$

A flag contains the dove-shaped design shown on a $4 \times 6$ grid. The area of the design is $192 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$, and its perimeter consists of straight lines and circular arcs. What are the dimensions of the flag?
Choices:
A:$6 \mathrm{~cm} \times 4 \mathrm{~cm}$
B:$12 \mathrm{~cm} \times 8 \mathrm{~cm}$
C:$20 \mathrm{~cm} \times 12 \mathrm{~cm}$
D:$24 \mathrm{~cm} \times 16 \mathrm{~cm}$
E:$30 \mathrm{~cm} \times 20 \mathrm{~cm}$

The diagram shows congruent rectangles and one triangle. The parts of the rectangles outside the triangle are shaded grey. What is the resulting grey area?
Choices:
A:$10 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
B:$12 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
C:$14 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
D:$15 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
E:$21 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$

A triangle is folded along the dashed line as shown. The area of the triangle is 1.5 times the area of the resulting figure, and the total area of the grey parts is 1. Determine the area of the starting triangle.
